name: JUNCTION TERMINAL BLOCKS
text:
Sauna contains a bunch of electrical parts and a junction terminal block is a device that helps to secure the wiring.

Junction terminal block is a part that contains several terminal connectors arranged in a sequence with an insulating frame.

Wires to the ground or to connect electrical parts and switches connected to a control panel may require a junction terminal block.

If you’re looking to find a replacement or an upgrade, you can chose one here.

Use the troubleshooting contact form if you’re not sure if you need to fix those devices, if you suspect that they stopped working or if there are other issues with your infrared sauna.

We hope to help you find a way to improve your infrared sauna
text_short: Junction terminal block is a device that consists of several terminal connectors arranged in a long strip with insulating frame. It is used to secure or terminate wires, to connect wiring to a ground or connect electrical outlets and switches to the mains. This device helps to attach wires in the same circuit without splicing or cutting them.
